title: mentha longifolia var. gracilis
intro: Mentha longifolia var. gracilis, commonly known as Long-leaved Pennyroyal, is a subspecies of the Mentha longifolia plant, a type of perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve stress and anxiety, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Long-leaved Pennyroyal include its antiseptic, anti-spasmodic, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, particularly pulegone and menthone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
